"""Main-owned baseline checks before the source-only stream recovery port."""
from pathlib import Path
import fcntl
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
import re
import traceback

B = Path('/home/yayoi/.local/state/strata-sycl/post-reboot-tuning-20261007')
W = Path('/home/yayoi/ghq/github.com/yqYo1/Strata/.worktree/perf-native-copy-cohorts-qualified-20261012')
L = Path('/home/yayoi/ghq/github.com/MistVVK/XeStrata/.worktree/fix-xestrata-e32-host-handoff-20261011/.lint')
O = B / 'xe-llvm-v711-source-v5/direct_owner.py'
assert hashlib.sha256(O.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == 'a29d8257eecc77c4ad9ae6671d092b56f4c09a35c4247c125fed3a8c8bc1f95f'
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('current_update_baseline_owner', O)
m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(m)
ENV = dict(PATH=str(L / 'venv/bin') + ':' + str(L / 'bin') + ':/usr/bin:/bin', HOME='/home/yayoi',
           LANG='C.UTF-8', LC_ALL='C.UTF-8', PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE='1', HF_HUB_OFFLINE='1',
           TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE='1', MYPY_CACHE_DIR='/dev/null', RUFF_OUTPUT_FORMAT='concise')

with (B / 'owned-v0141-measurement.lock').open('a') as lock:
    fcntl.flock(lock, fcntl.LOCK_EX | fcntl.LOCK_NB)
    out = B / 'main-current-update-server-baseline-root-v1'
    assert not out.exists()
    out.mkdir()
    r = dict(active=True, complete=False, passed=False, commands=[], gpu_executed=False, model_executed=False,
             source={'path': str(Path(__file__)), 'sha256': m.sha(Path(__file__))}, evidence={})

    def save():
        (out / 'record.json').write_text(json.dumps(r, indent=2) + '\n')

    owner = m.Owner(out / 'commands', save)
    r['commands'] = owner.commands

    def run(label, argv, allowed=(0,), wall=300):
        c, so, se = owner.run(label, argv, ENV, W, wall=wall, cpu=wall * 8 + 60,
                             rss_cap=16 << 30, text_cap=32 << 20, total_cap=64 << 20)
        r['evidence'][label] = dict(stdout=so.read_text(), stderr=se.read_text())
        save()
        assert m.closed(c) and c['session_anchored'] and c['exit_code'] in allowed, label
        return so.read_text(), se.read_text()

    try:
        assert run('head', ['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'])[0].strip() == '3141c18ea5d7156c79898237e06187d72159329e'
        assert not run('clean-source', ['git', 'status', '--porcelain', '--untracked-files=all'])[0].strip()
        tracked = run('tracked', ['git', 'ls-files', 'serve'])[0].splitlines()
        r['server_source_pins'] = {p: m.sha(W / p) for p in tracked if (W / p).is_file()}
        so, se = run('baseline-lints', ['/bin/bash', 'tools/lint/run.sh', 'serve/server.py',
                                      'serve/telemetry.py'], (0, 1))
        for tool in ('flake8', 'ruff', 'mypy', 'codespell', 'reuse'):
            assert '== ' + tool in so, tool
        assert 'skipped (' not in so and 'possible secret' not in so
        assert not so.split('== reuse\n')[-1].strip()
        so, se = run('baseline-server-regression', [str(L / 'venv/bin/python3'), '-B', '-m', 'unittest',
                                                   'discover', '-s', 'serve', '-p', 'test_*.py', '-v'], wall=900)
        hit = re.search(r'Ran (\d+) tests in ([0-9.]+)s', se)
        assert hit and re.search(r'^OK(?:\s|$)', se, re.M) and int(hit[1]) >= 566
        skip = re.search(r'^OK \(skipped=(\d+)\)', se, re.M)
        r['unittests'] = dict(tests=int(hit[1]), elapsed_seconds=float(hit[2]), skipped=int(skip[1]) if skip else 0,
                              individual_results=[v for v in se.splitlines() if v.startswith('test_')])
        assert all(m.sha(W / p) == h for p, h in r['server_source_pins'].items())
        r['complete'] = True
    except BaseException as error:
        r['error'] = repr(error)
        r['traceback'] = traceback.format_exc()
    finally:
        r.update(active=owner.active is not None, finished_utc=m.utc())
        r['passed'] = bool(r['complete'] and not r['active'] and not r.get('error'))
        save()
    print(json.dumps({k: r.get(k) for k in ('passed', 'complete', 'error', 'unittests')}))
    raise SystemExit(0 if r['passed'] else 1)
